title: 축척 혼합 없이 W2 병렬 가지만 쓴 모델(C2)의 센서 전이: C2MS의 WV2 이득 원인 분리
hypothesis: the WV2 transfer gain of C2MS over the original (54) comes from the 2x coarser pair training, not only from the W2 capacity: C2MS > C2 on WV2 (and C2 close to C0)

arms.C2: original + W2 parallel branch (43 C2), original pairs only; built exactly like 54 C2MS of the same seed (identical initial weights)
arms.C0 (54): original SSA-MRN K4, WV3 seeds 42-44 from experiment 54 (comparison arm, not retrained)
arms.C2MS (54): original + W2, original + 2x coarser pairs, WV3 seeds 42-44 from experiment 54 (comparison arm, not retrained)

transfer_tests.WV2: WV3-trained models evaluated on the WV2 test set (PanCollection convention; WV2 has no training data)

precision: FP16 AMP core training; FP32 transforms/loss/validation/evaluation
loss: per-pixel MSE on the original batch only (coarse_weight 0); the 2x coarser validation pairs of 54 are logged only
selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE including epoch0, earliest exact tie (43/53 rule); coarse validation is logged only
sensor_operators: 54 prepare.py SENSORS (WV3 toolbox MS GNyq, PAN 0.14; WV2 MS [0.35x7, 0.27], PAN 0.11), phase 2

judgement.criteria: docs/judgement_criteria.md v2.3 with the 54 sensor Wald operators; fixed before training
judgement.primary: WV2 transfer: C2MS (54) vs C2 of the same seeds, v2.3 label on 3-seed means; if C2MS improves over C2, the WV2 gain of C2MS is attributed to the scale-mixed training
judgement.secondary: WV2 transfer: C2 vs C0 (54) (capacity effect without scale mixing); WV3: C2MS vs C2 and C2 vs C0 with the same criteria
judgement.diagnostic: WV2 sharpness (mean |Laplacian| ratio to GT), detail correlation and per-band mean bias for C0, C2, C2MS (seeds 42-44), as measured for the 54 WV2 images
judgement.qualitative: result images with common/result_images.py on scenes 0, 1, 3, 7, 14, 17 of WV2 (C2 vs C2MS, seed 42)
judgement.reported_only: FR QNR, D_lambda, D_s; coarse-scale validation
judgement.note: noise thresholds and guard tolerances were derived from QB seed variation and are applied unchanged

limits: C0 and C2MS are the 54 runs (same code, data, seeds and schedule); C2 is trained here in a separate runtime
WV3 training only; WV2 is a transfer test
